selection: smallest measured deployment passing both full-dev targets among bounded tested configurations
holdout_policy: Consumed holdout not evaluated; no new independent quality claim
train_targets: gold plus frozen teacher logits (T=2) and normalized pooled features; train only
loss: 0.5 CE(label smoothing .02) + 0.5 T^2 KL + .05 normalized pooled feature MSE
vocabulary: observed raw train pieces plus Latin ASCII byte special fallbacks; exact all-train segmentation audit
schedule: h64/e64/l1 then h32/e32/l1 if pass, otherwise h128/e64/l1; third h16/e16/l1 if h32 passes or h256/e96/l2 if h128 fails
